data.title: Implement per-timeline styled themes (theme system + MCP tool)
data.description:
Each timeline carries its own visual identity — freeform per-scheme hex accents, a canvas wash, a curated display font, and a texture — set from the canvas settings (owner-only) and by the MCP client, which also gets imageStyle/mood metadata for coherent future image generation.

Shipped on branch `feat/timeline-themes` @ commit 324bf1f.

### What landed
- `timelines.theme` JSON column (migration 0017); `TimelineTheme` contract + shared Zod schema (`domain/theme.ts`).
- `setTimelineTheme` DB fn + RPC; theme flows into the getGraph payload; live via the existing SSE `view` path.
- `set_timeline_theme` MCP tool with WCAG contrast warnings (`mcp/theme-warnings.ts`); theme in get_timeline + resource; `create_timeline` accepts an initial theme.
- `resolveTimelineTheme` CSS-var layer on `.canvas-root` — re-declares the `:root`-baked aliases (`--primary`/`--ring`/`--xy-*`) and derives soft tints in JS to dodge the lightningcss color-mix bake; styles.css var hooks (zero-diff unthemed) + 5 lazy fontsource families + paper texture.
- Owner-gated Theme section in CanvasSettings + ThemeEditorDialog (live preview) + an `Ask your agent` copy-prompt.

### Verified
typecheck + build clean · `verify:theme` (19 asserts) green · `e2e/theme.spec.ts` + `set_timeline_theme` round-trip in `e2e/mcp.spec.ts` green.

### Caveat
Theme hunks in TimelineCanvas.tsx + layout-report.ts left uncommitted (co-mingled with concurrent VERBS-T2 gap work) — see local-82. Sits alongside the alive-canvas verb work (local-74/75).

data.title: Implement GLOBE G1 — data contract: lat/lng on NodeMetadata + apply_patch + layout report
data.description:
The globe lens data foundation (no UI). Refs: docs/product/prd/globe-lens.md (Technical design §1, §2).

### Scope
- Add `lat?: number`/`lng?: number` to `NodeMetadata` (schema.ts) + `GraphNode` DTO (domain/types.ts). JSON metadata column → NO migration.
- DTO flow: add lat/lng to the hand-mapped serializer in server/graph.ts:49 AND the query_timeline/get_node rows (server.ts:305,348) so the MCP client can read back what it located.
- MCP ops (mcp/ops.ts): add `lat` (z.number().min(-90).max(90).optional()) + `lng` (min(-180).max(180)) to add_node AND update_node opSchema branches with describe() hints; merge into metadata assembly (additive, pair-guarded).
- warnings.ts: lone-coordinate (lat without lng or vice versa) + null-island (0,0) per-patch warnings via coordinateWarnings(ops) wired into collectPatchWarnings. NO ocean/landmass check (deferred — needs server TopoJSON).
- layout-report.ts: new `coordinates` section { total, located, coveragePct, hasLocationNoCoords, sample[12] } after nodeIndex build.
- node-verb-prompts.ts: buildGlobeBackfillPrompt (so the backfill loop works before the globe renders).

### Done when
apply_patch accepts+validates lat/lng; get_layout_report returns coordinates section; Patch undo restores coords for free (metadata snapshot); typecheck + build green; no migration.

Add `location` + `lat`/`lng` to the geo-locatable seed nodes so the globe renders on a fresh install and success metrics have a baseline. Refs: globe-lens.md Technical design §0/§8. No code changed. Stoicism coordinates are researched and ready (city-level, anchored on the place most associated with the work; birthplace goes in the display string only):

- The Stoa Poikile — "Athens, Greece" — 37.98, 23.72
- Zeno of Citium — "Athens, Greece (b. Citium, Cyprus)" — 37.98, 23.72
- Cleanthes — "Athens, Greece" — 37.98, 23.72

data.title: Implement GLOBE G2 — globe lens component (d3-geo orthographic, markers, theme)
data.description: GlobeLens.tsx in src/components/canvas/, client-only behind <ClientOnly>, lazy-imported. d3-geo geoOrthographic + geoPath + geoGraticule10 + geoDistance (back-face marker culling); country mesh from world-atlas countries-110m.json via topojson-client. SVG (not canvas) — hit-testing + CSS-var theming for free at 100s of nodes. Markers inherit .canvas-root theme vars (--color-accent-primary, --color-accent-era). Static (non-playing) view first. Deps: d3-geo ^3.1.1, topojson-client ^3.1.0, world-atlas ^2.0.2 + @types. Do NOT add three/globe.gl/d3 umbrella/geocoder. Refs: globe-lens.md Technical design §5, §7. Depends on G1.

data.title: Implement GLOBE G3 — playback: scrubber, play/pause, non-linear time, spans
data.description: Time cursor = cursorInstant (epoch-ms). Reuse makeTimeScale(instants, pxPerDay, collapseGaps:true) from useTimelineScale.ts — playback advances LINEARLY IN X-SPACE; cursorInstant = scale.toInstant(x) → density-uniform sweep (no new bucketer; OQ6 dissolved). rAF loop, 3-speed toggle (1×/2×/4×), drag-scrub, prefers-reduced-motion → default paused. Events appear at startInstant and stay; spans glow active / dim (~30%) after endInstant. BCE + year-precision: integer instants, formatInstant for labels (already BCE-aware). Auto-center rotation on active node, override on manual drag, resume on play (OQ3). Refs: globe-lens.md §4. Depends on G2.

data.title: Implement GLOBE G4 — coverage gate + top-center view switcher + backfill prompt
data.description: ViewSwitcher: a top-center floatChip ToggleGroup (Timeline | Globe) in the .top-bar, absolute-centered (left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2), driving lensView state in TimelineCanvas. Render ONLY when ≥1 coordinated node; coverage state (N=5/30% gate) in the Globe item tooltip when below threshold; NOT rendered at zero coords (top bar identical to today). Shows for public viewers (read-only nav). Coverage computed client-side from in-memory graph. Backfill: zero-coords → ⌘K 'Set up globe view' PromptSpec (globeBackfillSpec via buildGlobeBackfillPrompt) + NodeDetailPanel location-row affordance; below-threshold → coverage banner in the globe with copyable backfill prompt (PromptDialog). 'Switch to globe' (≥1 coord) is a plain CommandPalette NAV action, NOT a verbs.ts entry. Refs: globe-lens.md §Entry/exit, §Coverage gate, Technical design §3. Depends on G2, G3.

data.title: Implement GLOBE G5 — click marker → NodeDetailPanel in its dock
data.description: Marker onClick sets selectedId (existing TimelineCanvas state) → the existing NodeDetailPanel opens in its usual right dock, edit mode unchanged. Closing the panel does NOT change lensView (stays in globe). Globe reads --detail-panel-w to inset its right edge so it never sits under the dock. Refs: globe-lens.md §Exit, Technical design §3. Depends on G2, G3.

data.title: Implement GLOBE G6 — SSE hot-update verification in the globe lens
data.description: Thin verification (near-zero build per Technical design §6): GlobeLens consumes the SAME ['graph', timelineId] query result the canvas does (passed as a prop, not its own fetch), so a live apply_patch refetch re-renders markers with no globe-specific code. The one rule: playback state (cursorInstant, playing, userRotated, rAF) lives in GlobeLens local state and must SURVIVE a nodes prop change — no remount, clamp cursor into the new extent if it grows. Verify a coordinate-adding patch lights a new marker mid-session without resetting playback. Refs: globe-lens.md §SSE. Depends on G2, G4, G5.

data.title: Implement GLOBE G7 — PostHog analytics (6 client events)
data.description: Wire 6 client events via posthog/client.ts capture seam: globe_lens_opened {timeline_id,node_count,coordinated_count,coverage_pct}, globe_playback_started {timeline_id,speed}, globe_scrubbed {timeline_id}, globe_marker_clicked {timeline_id,node_id,node_type}, globe_lens_closed {timeline_id,session_duration_ms,played}, globe_backfill_prompt_copied {timeline_id,uncoordinated_count}. Coordinate-adoption is the existing mcp_tool_called(apply_patch) with lat/lng — no new server event. Refs: globe-lens.md §Analytics. Depends on G4, G5.
